nodes.label: Aukaria Platform
nodes.rationale: Core goal: analyze Colombian property records (CTL PDFs from SNR) using Claude API to emit legal risk diagnoses, interactive timelines, and executable Word reports (.docx).

nodes.label: Aukaria Web SPA Entry (CTL Legal Audit Page)
nodes.norm_label: aukaria web spa entry (ctl legal audit page)
nodes.rationale: Minimal Vite entry page: root div container + module script /src/main.jsx, lang=es, title 'Aukaria · Auditoría jurídica de CTL' — the React SPA mounts here.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture One-Way Layering
nodes.rationale: Project references enforce one-way layering (Api → Application, Infrastructure → Application/Domain, Application → Domain, Domain → none); never add a reference upward.

nodes.label: Core Workflow (Upload → LLM → Dashboard → Report)
nodes.rationale: 1) Upload & fast pre-analysis extracts FMI in <500ms to avoid duplicate API costs; 2) LLM orchestration sends CTL text to Claude API in strict JSON mode; 3) interactive dashboard renders viability traffic lights; 4) on-demand .docx report injection.

nodes.label: waitFor Polling Function
nodes.rationale: Generic polling helper that polls a condition every 10ms with an explicit timeout error; arbitrary delays create race conditions that pass on fast machines but fail under load.

nodes.label: Four Validation Layers
nodes.rationale: Validate at EVERY layer data passes through (Entry Point, Business Logic, Environment Guards, Debug Instrumentation) because a single check can be bypassed by different code paths, refactoring, or mocks.

nodes.label: Backward Call-Stack Tracing
nodes.rationale: Fixing where the error appears treats a symptom; trace backward through the call chain (what called this, what value was passed) to find the original trigger and fix at the source.

nodes.label: The Four Phases
nodes.rationale: 4-phase systematic process (Investigation → Pattern Analysis → Hypothesis → Implementation) extracted from ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md; each phase must be completed before the next.

nodes.label: The Iron Law
nodes.rationale: Use ALWAYS/NEVER language (not should/try to) so the mandate 'NO FIXES WITHOUT ROOT CAUSE INVESTIGATION FIRST' resists rationalization under time pressure.

nodes.label: Question Architecture (3+ Failed Fixes)
nodes.rationale: 3+ failed fixes each revealing new problems in different places indicates a wrong architecture, not a failed hypothesis; STOP and question fundamentals instead of attempting fix #4.

nodes.label: Red Flags & Anti-Patterns
nodes.rationale: Most important bulletproofing: the anti-patterns section shows the exact shortcuts that feel justified in the moment; seeing 'I'll just add this one quick fix' listed as wrong creates cognitive friction.

nodes.label: Root Cause Mandate
nodes.rationale: ALWAYS find root cause before fixes; symptom fixes are failure. Mandate repeated in overview, when_to_use, Phase 1, and implementation rules to resist rationalization.

nodes.label: Single Hypothesis Rule
nodes.rationale: Form one specific hypothesis and test it with the smallest possible change (one variable at a time) to prevent shotgun fixes and isolate what worked.
